observed.caption: People walk up a winding dirt road toward large wind turbines on a grassy hill under a cloudy sky.
observed.description: A wide unpaved dirt road with gravel and tire ruts winds uphill through grassy terrain toward a hilltop. Several tall white wind turbines with three blades stand on the hill, with one prominent turbine on the right and two more visible in the distance on the left and center. A metal lattice communication tower stands beside the central turbine, and a small cluster of trees is on the hill crest near a fence line. A white vehicle is parked on the grass near the base of the closest turbine. On the left side of the road, wooden utility poles with wires recede into the distance. Seven people seen from behind walk away from the camera along the road, three in the foreground and four smaller figures further up the road, wearing casual clothing including dark pants, light tops and a backpack. The sky is mostly overcast with white and gray clouds and patches of blue, and the lighting is diffused daylight.
